name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) only requires a toggle at or after each ringing step; it does not require the siren to be off afterward. The task says to turn it off whenever it rings, so use a rule that requires the siren to be silent after each start (such as Response(siren_ringing, !siren_ringing) is not available in this clause language).
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, and Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) requires toggling the switch at or after each siren-ring step.

texts: Whenever the siren rings, toggle the switch at that step or later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u3, switch_toggled) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u3) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled, u2) -> 12
(u3, switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
